data.name: Animora
data.detailed_description:
💻 Meet Your Favorite Characters on Your Desktop：

Animora is a desktop companion designed to bring your creative visions to life. We believe your favorite characters deserve to be more than just static 2D images. Now, you can give them a 3D soul and let them step out of your folders to become your very own desktop partner.

🪄 Inside Animora, You Will Discover:

  • Creative Dreams Made Real: Turn your text descriptions or reference art into high-fidelity 3D characters in no time.

  • Instant Magic, No Effort: Skip the complex technical hurdles. Our automated process brings your characters to life instantly without any professional skills required.

  • Heartfelt Conversations: Your companion is a warm listener with an expressive voice, ready to share secrets and chat about anything on your mind.

  • Soothing Presence: As you spend time together, your companion will naturally perform various motions, creating a deeply immersive and private atmosphere on your screen.

  • A Personality Just for You: Define their name, traits, and backstory. Through shared memories, they will grow to understand you better every day.

💡 Important Notes

  • Language Support:

    • Text Chat: Supports EN, CN, JP, KR, FR, DE, ES, IT, PT.

    • Voice Chat: Supports EN and CN only.

  • Subscription & "Points":

    • Certain features (e.g., Image Gen, 3D Gen, Voice Chat) require "Points".

    • User Experience: Non-subscribers will have access to a limited trial experience only.

    • Exclusive Access: Point top-up is exclusive to Subscribers. Subscribers can purchase additional points and enjoy extended conversation memory.

  • Internet: A stable connection is required for AI features.

data.short_description: Animora is a desktop companion that brings 2D art to life as intelligent 3D entities. Convert descriptions into 3D characters that engage in voice chats and express emotions via real-time motion. With custom personas and evolving memory, Animora offers a soulful companion on your screen.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Microphone and speakers required for voice interaction
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High-quality microphone recommended for optimal voice interaction

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains some revealing clothing and minor partial nudity.
